note: Attacker-controlled count (nval) parsed from the CRAM compression-header stream; no upper-bound check is applied to it.
Loop iterates nval times, but rmap has only 256 entries; the loop bound i < nval is never clamped to the array capacity, so i can exceed 255.
Each map value is read from the stream; only the per-value check v >= 256 exists, which does not limit the count.

code: c->u.xpack.rmap[i] = v; // reverse map: e.g 0-3 to P,A,C,K
note: Writes the reverse-map entry at index i; when nval > 256 the write lands past the end of the malloc'd cram_codec object (uint32_t rmap[256]), a heap-buffer-overflow write.
